text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love became the second Triple Tiara Umamusume in history.
Not only that, she achieved yet another great feat—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Undefeated Triple Crown".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just the Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho,
but their respective prep races as well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Fillies' Revue,"
"Flora Stakes," "Rose Stakes."
A title granted only to those who have conquered all three.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those victories, Mejiro Ramonu was hailed
as the flawless "Miss Perfect."
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love, too, had grasped that glorious title.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To celebrate the great feat Still in Love achieved, I invited her to celebrate her undisputed Triple Tiara on our day off.
choice_data_list: A perfect Triple Crown— that's truly incredible!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It is entirely thanks to you,
Trainer, for guiding me this far.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it were just me alone, in the first place...
I probably wouldn't have even thought of achieving the Undefeated Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So... congratulations to you as well.
Happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘After all, it's Still in Love's own strength.’
I continued. Looking back, every single victory
was one she had earned for me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words—she's truly an incredible Umamusume.
Even if she asked for something low-key,
I want to celebrate her with all my might...!
choice_data_list: Actually, I've already got it ready. Let's go!
Actually, I've already got it ready. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought Still in Love to the space I had rented for today. There—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Financiers... Victoria sponge,
madeleines... sablés... scones—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Far Breton... Galette Bretonne...!
So many delicious baked treats...
choice_data_list: I went around to all kinds of shops to gather them up

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love loves sweet treats.
If so, I want her to enjoy them to her heart's content—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Focusing mainly on baked goods that would keep well,
I researched as many shops as possible and visited them...
Sometimes even waiting in line for an hour after opening...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I lined up in remote places at times, and fought for first-come slots or entered lotteries online at others. The confectionery world was deeper than I thought, but—
choice_data_list: For you, even waiting in line was fun
For you, even waiting in line was fun!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so, so happy.
Truly... but..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to join you too!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "I wanted to walk side-by-side with you, chatting about all sorts of things, waiting to encounter sweets..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Surprises are wonderful, of course, but...
I also wanted us to share the moment together.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Next?
choice_data_list: We can celebrate as many times as you want in the future, right?
We can celebrate as many times as you want in the future, right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, while snacking on sweets with Still in Love, we spent a modest yet enjoyable time celebrating—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I returned to the academy, outside the Trainer's Office...
An Umamusume with bluish hair
was standing alone, holding a bouquet of flowers.

text_block_list.name: Bluish-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you're holding a
celebration for Still-san...

text_block_list.name: Bluish-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara... No, congratulations
on the Undefeated Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My...
Thank you, very much...

text_block_list.name: Bluish-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I've been secretly watching the two of you...
working side by side to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Bluish-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
They are who I look up to. The two of them...
—as if bound together by the red thread of fate.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: N-No way... T-The red thread of fate, you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Bluish-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I want to achieve flawless results on the Tiara route just like the two of you.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Bluish-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Please guide me one day, too!
—Trainer-san. See you later!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You're quite popular, aren't you? As expected of you, Trainer...
I feel proud too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we store the leftover sweets
in the freezer?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(It's okay, Trainer-san won't be stolen away.
Because...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Your red string of fate—
is tied to me now.)
